name: List All Delinquent Charges
description: Returns all delinquent charges that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the delinquent charge

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the property associated with the delinquent charge. Accepts comma-separated values for multiple properties.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the delinquent charge

responseFields.name: data[].AmountDue
responseFields.description: The current amount outstanding for the delinquent charge

responseFields.name: data[].ChargedOn
responseFields.description: ChargedOn dates from the past indicate an outstanding charge(s) that have not yet been paid that are "owed." The endpoint will return all currently outstanding charges with their respective amounts and ChargedOn date.

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief summary or description of the delinquent charge

responseFields.name: data[].GlAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the general ledger account associated with the delinquent charge

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy associated with the delinquent charge

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The last time the delinquent charge was updated. On the date the charge becomes delinquent, this value will always be the current time.

responseFields.name: data[].Subsidy
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the delinquent charge is subsidized

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
